name: tmux sessions
author: eztvn
description: Bar widget with the live count of tmux sessions on this machine plus a popup listing every session with its window count, idle age and two actions per row: attach it in a terminal or eliminate it after an explicit confirmation (two steps for sessions someone is attached to). A header action eliminates every session after a confirmation that spells out how many sessions and which attached ones would be lost.

barWidget.description: Session count in the bar, popup list of tmux sessions with one-click attach and confirmed elimination.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the widget re-reads the tmux session list.
